elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "(ii) for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner."

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation."

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The inserted software warranty runs only "for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery"; no 12-month term appears anywhere.
The services warranty runs only "for a period of thirty (30) days following performance".

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: "Client's remedy ... is, at TrueLink's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or Services".
"... or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or Services."

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No compliance-with-laws warranty appears in Section 9 as rendered; the insertion covers only conformance, workmanlike performance and remedies.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No malicious-code / virus warranty is present in the rendered operative language.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: "for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation" — the item is expressly software, satisfying the software-to-documentation requirement.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: "for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner" — both service categories are defined terms in the Agreement (Sections 3 and 4).

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: Remedy sentence expressly provides "repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or Services".
Remedy sentence expressly provides "a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or Services".

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: 90-day software-to-documentation warranty, 30-day services warranty, and repair/replacement or refund remedy all appear in operative language, not merely in the comment.

Preferred level is not reached: the software period is 90 days rather than 12 months, the services period is 30 days rather than 90 days, and there is no compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranty. Classification as a deviation cured to fallback is correct.

Minimal: the edit is a single concise insertion into the existing Section 9; the Year 2000 warranty, the evidence/repair mechanics and the Section 12 disclaimer are all retained verbatim, with no deletions, survival tails, expense language or extra procedures added. The 'professional and workmanlike' standard is the necessary substantive content of the 30-day services warranty, not an extra.

Preserves intent: the Section 12 disclaimer is already prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so it does not swallow the new express warranty and correctly required no amendment; no undefined terms or dangling cross-references are created (Hosting Services and Support Services are defined).

Optional drafting nit (not a failure): the remedy sentence says "this warranty" while the preceding sentence contains two warranties — consider "these warranties" to avoid any argument that the remedy attaches only to the conformance limb.
